Vectorint keeps your budget data on your device.

Vectorint does not create an account. K2040 does not receive, upload, sell, or share your personal or financial data. Vectorint contains no advertising, analytics, telemetry, or tracking and does not request Android’s internet permission.

Vectorint stores financial amounts, transaction records, user-created text, recurring dates and reminder information, and app settings in its private app storage. It does not access your Android system calendar.

Manual and automatic backups are readable JSON files saved where you choose through Android. Vectorint retains access only to the automatic-backup folder you select and does not upload backup files or connect directly to a backup or cloud service. A third-party document provider may process or synchronize files according to its own privacy policy.
If you enable reminders, Vectorint asks Android for notification permission and schedules reminders locally. Lock-screen reminder notifications omit financial details.
Remove local Vectorint data through Android’s app settings or by uninstalling the app. Backup files remain wherever you saved them and must be removed separately.
